incident-bot: PAGER: sev2 - model warmup failures across us-west-2 GPU pool. Detected 15 failed warmups in last 5m. Affected service: redwood-hosted. Paging oncall: @alice (oncall).

alice (oncall): Got the page, looking. Any immediate customer impact? :eyes:

incident-bot: Metrics: 5xx ratio spiking from 0.2% -> 4.7%, average model-load latency for new containers 2.3s -> 12s, 12 container crashes observed.

bob (eng-runtime): I see repeated OOMs during model deserialization in the warmup step on pods: rwd-serve-47*, rwd-serve-49*. Logs show GPU oom while allocating KV cache.

carla (eng-sre): Can you paste a snippet of the greedy OOM stack? we need to decide drain/evacuate nodes.

bob (eng-runtime): Paste from pod rwd-serve-4712 log:

```
2024-06-15T18:04:12Z ERROR runtime: model_load failed: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
stack: runtime/warmup.go:142 warmupModel
model/deserialize.go:87 readWeights -> EOF while reading weight chunk
compile/engine.go:241 timeout waiting for kernel compile
```

bob (eng-runtime): Two distinct failures: 1) GPU OOM during cudaMalloc, 2) EOF during model deserialization (artifact truncated), 3) occasional compile timeout. Might be correlated with a spike in concurrent warmups after a routing change.

dave (eng-ml): Which model variants are failing? heavy.quant & heavy.fp16?

bob (eng-runtime): heavy-13b-fp16 and heavy-7b-quant both had issues. heavier models fail OOM, quant one shows deserialization EOF on the same node images.

frank (eng-infra): Node telemetry shows a recent kernel update yesterday and an older NVIDIA driver on that pool. Also docker image pulls stalled earlier (registry latency). Could be partial image writes -> truncated artifacts on disk.

alice (oncall): Immediate mitigation proposals: A) remove warmup from routing for new containers (disable auto-warmup), B) temporarily route new requests to cold fallback model (small-3b), C) cordon/evacuate suspect nodes. Thoughts?

bob (eng-runtime): A + C in parallel. Disable warmup globally for the pool to prevent repeated OOMs from compounding. Then cordon nodes with disk I/O errors to avoid serving truncated artifacts. We'll revert routing after stabilization.

carla (eng-sre): I'm on cordon/evac now. Which node list? frank, can you share affected node IDs?

frank (eng-infra): Affected: gpu-q1-14, gpu-q1-17, gpu-q1-22. Disk write errors around 18:01-18:07 UTC. I'll drain gpu-q1-17 first.

deploy-bot: config change queued by bob: disable_auto_warmup=true for pool=us-west-2-gpu. Request ID: cfg-20240615-881.

bob (eng-runtime): Rolling out disable_auto_warmup config now. Command:

```
redwoodctl config set --pool us-west-2-gpu --disable-auto-warmup true --request-id cfg-20240615-881
```

bob (eng-runtime): Confirmed: warmup disabled for pool. New containers will skip model warmup step.

alece (typo-notice): (ignore)

alice (oncall): Starting customer impact triage. Eva, please check CS for any active tickets or customers on this pool.

eva (customer-success): Pinged CS triage. Two paying customers routed primarily to us-west-2: AcmeAnalytics (high throughput) and Payflow (low latency helm). Notified both with initial statement: we're investigating model load failures that may cause transient 5xxs; next update in 15m.

carla (eng-sre): After cordon of gpu-q1-17 and drain, error rate dropped from 4.7% -> 1.1% over 4 minutes. Still seeing deserialization EOFs from gpu-q1-22.

frank (eng-infra): Investigating registry layer: there were truncated blob uploads around 17:58 from the artifact pipeline. Suspect the artifact store had intermittent write failures; that could explain EOF. I'm starting a recheck and will re-pull artifacts to affected nodes.

bob (eng-runtime): As temporary customer-safe fallback, I've added a routing policy: if model load fails, fall back to model-3b-small automatically and log the event. Will add a metric tag for fallback_count.

incident-bot: Action taken: warmup disabled; nodes cordoned: gpu-q1-17; fallback routing policy enabled. Current severity: sev2. Impact: intermittent 5xx and increased cold-start latency for new sessions.

alice (oncall): Good. Next: re-pull artifact on gpu-q1-22 and restart container after verifying checksum. frank, coordinate that. bob, add a short-term compile timeout extension to avoid spurious compile timeouts during first run. dave, can you run a quick model sanity test on small-3b to validate fallback's output quality for impacted customers?

dave (eng-ml): Running quick eval against our prod prompt set now. small-3b reduces some long-form coherence but should be acceptable for Payflow transactions. For AcmeAnalytics, recommend informing them of potential lower quality for non-critical queries.

frank (eng-infra): Re-pulled artifact and verified checksum on gpu-q1-22: sha256 matches. Restarting container rwd-serve-229.

bob (eng-runtime): Increased compile timeout in runtime config: compile_timeout_ms from 10000 -> 30000 for pool us-west-2-gpu. Request ID cfg-20240615-882.

carla (eng-sre): After fixes, overall 5xx is back to baseline 0.3% and warmup failures stopped. One remaining truncated-artifact metric spike tied to artifact-pipeline node a1.

alice (oncall): Great work. We'll keep warmup disabled until patch to artifact uploader is applied. Postmortem items:
- infra: root cause analysis of artifact-store disk/write error and fix uploader retry semantics (owner: frank)
- runtime: add verification on artifact pull with immediate fallback to re-pull + checksum (owner: bob)
- ml: reduce default warmup memory footprint and add safer OOM guard for heavy models (owner: dave)
- ops: improve routing policy to limit concurrent warmups per node (owner: carla)

eva (customer-success): Customer comms: notifying AcmeAnalytics of lower quality possible and Payflow of potential latency changes. Drafts ready for review.

alice (oncall): Incident timebox: started 2024-06-15T18:03 UTC (thread_ts), mitigated 2024-06-15T18:45 UTC. I'll transition to post-incident slack channel once we have RCA notes. If anything else crops up, add to this thread. Thanks everyone :clap:

incident-bot: Incident update: incident resolved (mitigated) - monitoring will continue for 2 hours.

carla (eng-sre): Marking follow-up meeting for 2024-06-16 09:00 PT. Agenda: RCA, artifact uploader patch plan, runtime guards.

bob (eng-runtime): One last note: consider adding a pre-warm checksum verification step so we avoid loading truncated artifacts into GPU memory. I can prototype tomorrow.

frank (eng-infra): OK I'll start with artifact-store logs and uploader retries, will post first findings in the RCA thread.
